title: What a Real Aston Martin DB5 Costs Today
description:
A new Aston Martin DB5 cost four thousand one hundred seventy-five pounds in nineteen sixty-three. Today, the Hagerty price guide shows six hundred fifty-nine thousand dollars for a nineteen sixty-five car. A barn-find project once sold for five times its estimate. And a restored one cost four hundred thousand pounds to restore. What a real DB5 costs today depends on which sale you believe, and we show them all. Our sources are the Hagerty valuation page, RM Sotheby's, Bonhams reports from Classic and Sports Car and Supercars dot net, Top Gear, Auto123, Wikipedia, Old Cars Weekly and the Private Fleet blog, plus Census Bureau, Energy Information Administration and Kelley Blue Book figures. We show disagreements, and label our own arithmetic. Running costs are mostly not in our sources, and we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
